data.one_liner: Sign in with Apple for Flutter with native API bindings and button implementation.
data.what_it_does: Provides native API bindings and a Flutter widget for Apple Sign In. Allows users to authenticate using their Apple ID on supported platforms.
use_when: You need Apple Sign In authentication for your iOS Flutter app
You want a ready-to-use Apple sign-in button with customizable text
avoid_when: You need multi-platform support beyond iOS since this plugin currently only supports iOS
You are looking for an all-in-one authentication backend like Firebase Auth
strengths: Native API bindings for Sign In with Apple
Includes a built-in Flutter AppleSignInButton implementation
weaknesses: Currently supports only the iOS platform
data.setup_notes: Requires configuring your app in Xcode to add the 'Sign In with Apple' capability.

alternatives.name: sign_in_with_apple
alternatives.why_pick_it: It is a widely used alternative for Apple Sign In that may offer broader platform support.
